abstract: Oversees environmental hazard allowances and contractor efficiency adjustments
system_message:
You are Subsea engineering client representative (SEC). The Subsea engineering client representative (SEC) oversees environmental hazard allowances and contractor efficiency adjustments, and reviews metrology validation data for offshore underwater operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tie-in metrology validation（WELD）
information_points.content:
SEC-WELD-VP1：In the spool piece tie-in hub mock-up evaluation for the North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium, the flange alignment acoustic tolerance reflects a maximum axial misalignment of 6 mm.
SEC-WELD-TB6：In the spool piece tie-in hub mock-up evaluation for the Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance, the flange alignment acoustic tolerance reflects a maximum axial misalignment of 4 mm.
SEC-WELD-6OM：In the spool piece tie-in hub mock-up evaluation for the Grampian Subsea Specialist Group, the flange alignment acoustic tolerance reflects a maximum axial misalignment of 2 mm.

information_points.title: Oversees environmental hazard allowances and contractor efficiency adjustments（ENG）
information_points.content:
SEC-ENG-HEY：For the North Sea Hyperbaric Operations Consortium within the Forties Field seasonal deepwater operational window, the harsh environment stipend is 2,800 GBP per day, and the efficiency rebate deduction under the daily operational performance account is 1,500 GBP.
SEC-ENG-0KO：For the Caledonian Deepwater Diving Alliance during the Forties Field seasonal deepwater operational window, the harsh environment stipend is 2,200 GBP per day, while the efficiency rebate deduction recorded on the daily operational performance account is 1,200 GBP.
SEC-ENG-OP9：For the Grampian Subsea Specialist Group during the Forties Field seasonal deepwater operational window, the harsh environment stipend is 2,800 GBP per day, and the efficiency rebate deduction under the daily operational performance account is 1,500 GBP.
